Class SeasonalController

java.lang.Object
SeasonalController
public class SeasonalController extends Object
Controller for the New Seasonal Item window (seasonal.fxml).

Lets a manager add a new seasonal drink to the menu along with its recipe. The recipe can use existing inventory items and brand-new ones, which are created in inventory when the drink is saved. The menu item, any new inventory items, and the recipe are saved in a single transaction, so a failure saves nothing.

Author:
Riya Patel

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      private void initialize()
      Called by JavaFX after the FXML loads. Fills the item type choices and loads the category and ingredient dropdowns from the database.

    • loadChoices

      private void loadChoices()
      Fills the category and existing-ingredient dropdowns from the database.

    • addExisting

      private void addExisting()
      Adds the selected existing inventory item to the recipe with the amount entered. Shows a message instead if no item is chosen, the amount is not greater than 0, or the item is already in the recipe.

    • addNew

      private void addNew()
      Adds a brand-new inventory item to the recipe. The item is only created in the database when the drink is saved. Shows a message instead if a field is missing or invalid, or if an item with that name already exists in inventory or in the recipe.

    • removeIngredient

      private void removeIngredient()
      Removes the selected ingredient from the recipe, if one is selected.

    • saveItem

      private void saveItem()
      Validates the form, then saves the menu item, any new inventory items, and the recipe in one transaction. If any step fails, everything is rolled back and an error message is shown. Clears the form on success.
